status: fixed before any recovery generation; untested exploratory candidate
relationship_to_primary: Exploratory recovery designed after viewing primary benchmark results and long-response diagnostics. It does not replace, retune or change the frozen primary selection/training/evaluation experiment.
candidate: One fixed full-weight base-anchored interpolation: theta_recovery = 0.75 * theta_original_base + 0.25 * theta_advanced_final, computed and stored in FP32.

screen.purpose: Source-only development evidence; teacher-answer agreement is not verified ground truth and is not benchmark improvement.
screen.source: Exactly 1000 original source-heldout rows at deadline/artifacts/heldout.json, disjoint from the prepared training pool, final training sets and both probe reservations.
screen.selection: Deterministic 64 eligible native prompts, at most 2048 prompt tokens, with an extractable final boxed teacher answer; selected IDs and hashes saved before any generation.
screen.base_role_meaning: Original pinned base model, never a previous team checkpoint.
screen.system_prompt: Same fixed primary system prompt and native template.
screen.grader: Existing primary rule-based grader, interpreted only as teacher-answer agreement.
screen.outputs: Selected IDs, input/model/code hashes and answer-free per-example diagnostics; no source solutions or raw generations exported.

fixed_gate.teacher_answer_agreement_count: recovery >= advanced AND recovery >= original - 2, each out of the same fixed 64 examples
fixed_gate.length_finishes: 2 * recovery_length_finishes <= advanced_length_finishes; if advanced has zero, recovery must have zero
fixed_gate.meaning: Passing is development evidence only. No alpha, threshold, IDs, generation settings or gate changes after observing these results.

admission.full_benchmark_admission: Forbidden until terminal GPU-budget reclamation, the unchanged 48-GPU-hour cap, and completion/publication deadline reserves permit a separately labeled additional evaluation.
admission.primary_runs: Preserve all primary weights, data, raw outputs and publication gates unchanged. No primary incomplete result is replaced by a recovery result.

limitations: Post-hoc design after primary outcomes; one coefficient and one development screen do not establish novelty, general superiority or SOTA.
Weight interpolation is a hypothesis about reducing harmful drift; it is not additional data selection or additional SFT.
A 64-example, one-sample teacher-agreement screen has limited power and does not prove general reasoning correctness or benchmark improvement.
No recovery result, GPU admission or Hugging Face publication exists merely because this code and plan exist.
